name: TMK
recent: TMK Chemical 于2026年9月18日签署有条件买卖协议，拟以9.399亿令吉收购 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 100%股权，其中约4.385亿令吉以现金支付，其余通过发行2.625亿股新股支付。此外，公司宣派每股3.6仙中期股息，除权日为2026年10月7日。
notable: 拟以9.399亿令吉收购 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 100%股权，其中约4.385亿令吉以现金支付，其余通过发行2.625亿股新股支付。
宣派每股3.6仙中期单层股息，除权日2026年10月7日，派发日2026年11月4日。
risks: 收购代价包含发行2.625亿股新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
与 KLK Bioenergy Sdn Bhd 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出2026年4月28日通函所披露的估算值10%以上。
earnings: 2026年第二季度营收为3.10387亿令吉，环比增长28.6%，同比增长17.7%；净利为4081.1万令吉，环比增长35.4%，同比增长91.5%；净利率为13.1%，高于上一季度的12.5%。

recent_en: On 18 September 2026, TMK Chemical entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) for RM939.9 million, satisfied via approximately RM438.5 million cash and the issuance of 262.5 million new shares. The company also proposed to seek an exemption for Batu Kawan Berhad from the mandatory general offer obligation. Separately, an interim dividend of 3.6 sen per share was declared, with ex-date on 7 October 2026.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% of Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) for RM939.9 million, satisfied via approximately RM438.5 million cash and 262.5 million new shares.
Proposed exemption for Batu Kawan Berhad from the mandatory general offer obligation arising from the acquisition.
Declared interim single-tier dividend of 3.6 sen per share, ex-date 7 October 2026, payment date 4 November 2026.
risks_en: The acquisition consideration includes the issuance of 262.5 million new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders.
Actual value of recurrent related party transactions with KLK Bioenergy Sdn Bhd exceeded the estimated value disclosed in the circular dated 28 April 2026 by more than 10%.
earnings_en: For Q2 2026, revenue was RM310.387 million, up 28.6% QoQ and 17.7% YoY; net income was RM40.811 million, up 35.4% QoQ and 91.5% YoY; net margin was 13.1%, higher than 12.5% in the previous quarter.
